description: This is a shell script for testing the 'git rebase -i' (interactive rebase) functionality in a Git repository. It sets up various repository states, runs rebase commands with different options, and verifies the behavior through assertions, comparisons, and simulated user input. The script covers multiple scenarios including rebase actions, conflict handling, commit amendments, special commands (like reword, squash, fixup), handling of submodules, refs updates, and more. It uses test libraries to facilitate assertions and simulate user interactions.
